comment: Love her classes - would take them all if I could
Dr. Sholley's class is a lot of work. But just do it and you'll be fine. she's entertaining and witty.

Nice women outside of class but... She does not put a lot of work into her class, but she expects a lot out of her students. She will rarely teach. Mostly classes are filled with guest speakers, presentations, or movies, but you will be expected to remember every minute detail and apply it to all of the theories that she never actually taught.

Dr Sholley challenges her students to question current knowledge that we hold as truths. Guided by a feminist framework, she encourages us to reduce biases in psychology. This class is not easy, but it is very rewarding.
Great teacher.  Engaging class discussion.  Not too hard of a grader but assigned LOTS and LOTS and LOTS of work.

Dr. Sholley is a great Core teacher. She really makes her students think about the books. She tends to take a feminist route in discussions. She is excellent at leading discussions. She has a sarcastic sense of humor which can be intimidating at times, but always very funny. She'll make you work hard, but you'll also learn a lot.

Dr Sholley is a remarkable woman who pushes her students because she is passionate. The course work is demanding, but that shouldn't deter anyone from taking the gender course. This class will open your eyes to insightful topics, and you develop a very strong critical analysis of current research. I strongly recommend her.

She was tough but fair.  People looking to get by with the bare minimum need not apply.  She loves what she studies and wants you to, too.  She is approachable and helpful if you get up the nerve to ask for it.  She's not a spoonfeeder.

I love Dr. Sholley's class.  She challenges her students and is entertaining and fun in class.  It makes for a pretty relaxed atmosphere which has allowed for some great discussions.  While her work load may be tough, it is manageable.  Tests are hard, but she's a fair grader.
Lots of people are intimidated by her; however, I found her to be an effective communicator, and a fair judge of work

Sholley is tough, but if you keep up with the reading, you'll be fine...and you'll learn A LOT. She's hilarious in class, and it's obvious that she's passionate about social psychology. I'd recommend her class, but only if you don't have too heavy of a course load. She does have one mean syllabus.
Her tests are REALLY HARD, she assigns huge loads of reading (and makes it difficult to find the articles), and she grades hard on the presentations.  I DO NOT recommend her.
She is a horrendous Core teacher.  I have heard that she is good for some classes, but I can't stand her.  She is very **** (towards women) and hates those that disagree with her opinions.
Dr Sholley is one of the meanest women I have ever encountered.  She was biased towards all males in her class...always.  I would never take her agian...She is a ****

has her own strong views, esp. about Gender.  I have mixed feelings about class: too much reading to do, and lots of work, but good discussions and lots to reflect on.  I would not take another class with her.
